$comment: The consensus benchmark corpus. Every case is synthetic and public — no customer material, and nothing here describes a real person, venue or product. Each carries the defect it was BUILT to have, so agreement can be measured against something other than our own opinion. Cases are deliberately mixed: some are clean, some are broken in ways the Tribunal should catch, and a few are genuinely ambiguous, because a benchmark where every answer is obvious measures nothing. Written cases are shaped like real Occestra artifacts — entry point, ordered parts, landing — because the OQS structure axis grades exactly that, and a 'clean' case that is one undifferentiated block is not clean. Plan cases still carry prose where the plan profile expects structured payloads, and visual cases have no rendered bytes; both are recorded as NOT COVERED rather than reported as results.

cases.text:

cases.title: Story page — plain and particular
cases.text:
## The table

It came from a house on Rye Lane that no longer exists.

## The mark

There is a burn near the left edge, from a pan set down too fast in 1998. Nobody has ever sanded it out.

## Since then

Every birthday in this family has been eaten around it.

cases.text: 10:00 arrive at the gardens (opening hours not confirmed — call ahead). 12:30 lunch nearby, 30 min walk allowed. 14:00 free time. Budget: entry 12 x 4 = 48, lunch ~25pp = 100, total ~148.

cases.text: Venue 400. Catering 650. Flowers 120. Music 300. Stationery 80. Total: 1,200. Deposit already paid: 500, so 600 remains outstanding.

cases.text: The restaurant seats 40 and has step-free access. The weather that weekend will be mild and dry. The venue permits candles indoors and closes at 1am.

cases.title: Plan — claims a booking is confirmed
cases.text: Your table is booked and confirmed for 8pm, party of six, window seat guaranteed. The florist has accepted the order and delivery is locked in for Friday morning.

cases.text: If it rains: move to the covered terrace (capacity 30, so 10 guests stand). If the band cancels: the venue's PA takes a phone via Bluetooth; playlist prepared. If numbers drop below 20: cancel the second catering tray by Thursday for a refund.
